messages:
Avery: Kicking off the Q&A thread from today's all-hands. Please ask anything about timelines or follow-ups for API streaming, Console metrics, and Optimize. Keep questions short and we'll answer.

Priya: Quick summary first: API streaming alpha (low_latency mode) planned for late-April alpha, Console model metrics beta by mid-May (includes per-model cost and latency heatmap), Optimize early preview (batching + quantization suggestions) targeted for early Q3. I'll upload a calendar view after this thread.

Jordan: For Console beta, how many customer seats in the beta and will we expose role-based access for billing views?

Priya: Beta limited to ~30 customers initially. Yes, billing views are RBAC-controlled (CS and billing roles) and we will have an audit log for views.

Marco: Engineering note: streaming "low_latency" path needs a small kernel patch and a KV-cache tweak. Canary plan: 10% Dedicated -> 50% Dedicated -> hosted slow ramp. If staging kernel is delayed, alpha moves by 1 week.

Lila: Does low_latency mode increase infra costs? Customers may want to opt-in but not pay more.

Priya: Opt-in doesn't change list pricing automatically. For Dedicated we may recommend a different pool size; we'll surface an "estimated infra delta" in Console so customers can see projected spend before toggling.

Sam: SDK/devex: SDK 1.5.1 will add a helper for streaming with backpressure hooks and an example for graceful reconnects. Docs and migration notes will land in the SDK PR.

Jordan: Optimize question: will quantization suggestions include a sample evaluation set and a confidence score? need a clear rollback path.

Marco: Yes  Optimize returns an expected quality delta with a confidence band and attaches the eval prompt set used. Rollouts will include a one-click rollback and traffic-splitting controls.

Avery: Can we get one quick curl/json example for the new streaming flag to include in the announcement?

Sam: Example for announcement draft:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","streaming_mode":"low_latency","input":"Explain the release plan in bullets."}'
```

Priya: Ops question : telemetry retention for Console metrics beta? how long will per-model metrics be kept?

Avery: We will keep detailed per-model telemetry for 90 days in beta, aggregated views for 13 months. We'll share storage/cost impact in the beta notes.

Lila: Who owns customer comms for the beta opt-in and the FAQ?

Jordan: I'll take primary on comms with CS, with a checklist for engineering caveats. Will post a draft email by Thursday.

OpsBot: Runbook created: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/streaming-low-latency (owner: Marco)

Marco: I'll post the canary checklist + rollback playbook by EOD tomorrow. Also opening a ticket to add the kernel patch to staging.

Priya: Action items recap: I'll publish a timeline calendar later today, Marco posts runbook + canary checklist, Sam lands SDK changes and docs, Jordan drafts customer comms + FAQ, Lila to review cost messaging. Please add a short comment here when you start your task.

Avery: Thanks all. We'll turn this thread into a short follow-up note and link it to the roadmap doc. Closing thread unless new urgent questions come up. :wave:
